name: Latent Heat
source:
The trek back down to where you spent your childhood summers has been on the cards for a while now, but you've finally managed the trip out with your best friend. It's supposed to be a nice getaway from the daily stressors of the city life for some 20-somethings looking to have a little fun.

And it is fun, until your best friend starts seeing things.

Make the right calls, don't try to be a hero.

[From [url=https://puppypal.itch.io/latent-heat]]itch.io[/url]]
